description: This source file contains the implementation of the CustomerAttributeDao interface for accessing CustomerAttribute data objects in a sales management system. It uses QueryDSL for constructing JPQL queries to retrieve customer attribute data based on various criteria.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access object for CustomerAttribute entity, providing methods to fetch customer attribute data using QueryDSL queries.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerAttribute entity by its ID, including associations with customer, options, and descriptions.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute by option ID, customer ID, and MerchantStore, including relevant joins.

methods.name: getByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves all CustomerAttributes associated with a specific customer within a MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Fetches CustomerAttributes linked to a specific option value ID within a MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByOptionId (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes by option ID within a MerchantStore.
